title: Civil Code
text:
Law: Civil Code
Reference: Legislative Decree 84/1949
Date of Promulgation: Promulgated by President Husni Zaim on May 18, 1949

Relevant Provisions:
There are a total of 1,130 provisions in the Civil Code.

Addresses numerous matters including contracts, torts, sale of goods, securities, insolvency, assignment, property, lease agreements, the obligations of contractors and architects, employment, commercial agency, inheritance, etc.

Related Legislation:
Various areas of the Civil Code have since been legislated for separately, including the:

Commercial Code- Law 33/2007

Companies Law- Legislative Decree 29/2011

Employment Law 17/2010

Landlord and Tenant Law 6/2001

Historical Context:
During the short-lived 138-day rule of President Husni Zaim, essential pieces of legislation such as the Civil Code were produced and are still relevant to the present day.
